definitions.explanation: A vinegar mixture seasoned with sugar and salt, used to flavor sushi rice. Available pre-mixed commercially or made at home.

examples.japanese: {寿司酢|すしず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧。
{炊|た}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寿司酢|すしず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: Pour sushi vinegar over freshly cooked rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寿司酢|すしず}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{米酢|こめず}→米酢：24254_komezu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Homemade sushi vinegar is made by adding sugar and salt to rice vinegar.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧ (sushi) and ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧ (vinegar), with the reading of ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧ voiced to ず through sequential voicing (rendaku). This is a fundamental ingredient in Japanese cuisine, essential for making ⟦{酢飯|すめし}→酢飯：14460_sumeshi⟧ (vinegared sushi rice).

The basic ratio for homemade {寿司酢|すしず} is typically rice vinegar, sugar, and salt in roughly a 4:2:1 proportion, though recipes vary by region and personal preference.
